acceptance: changeGraph recognises a tool at any path depth: a path segment 'tools/<name>/' anywhere in the path (for example PresentationTier/ui/src/_components/tools/Billing/x.tsx is tool 'Billing', and .../tools/_shared/... is '_shared'), not only at the repository root

When a changed file lives under a tools/_shared/ directory (or is imported by any tool), changeGraph also finds its importers that did not change: scan tracked files with git ls-files for TS/JS files whose relative imports resolve to the changed module, and report '<module> is imported by N tools: a, b, c' when N >= 2

Non-relative specifiers that contain a tools/<name>/ segment (path aliases such as '@/_components/tools/Billing/hooks') are attributed to that tool by segment, so cross-tool alias imports appear as cross-tool edges

The #276 fixture: only tools/_shared/useThing.ts changes, three unchanged micro-apps under src/_components/tools/{A,B,C}/ import it (two by relative path, one by '@/' alias); the Relationships section names all three tools
